body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ''SCH-B500'' an S-DMB slim sliding mobile phone dubbed ''Slim&J'' during KES 2006. It supports CDMA2000 1x EV-DO (800MHz) and VOD/MOD service. It features 2.12-inch TFT-LCD, a 2M camera, microSD memory card slot, mp3 playback, Bluetooth connectivity, TV-out, "playing with my pet", black GUI, and a file viewer.
